name: Japan Wool Textile Co Ltd/The
summary: The Japan Wool Textile Co., Ltd., also known as Nippon Keori Co., Ltd., is an established Japanese enterprise primarily engaged in the textile industry. Its multifaceted operations are organized into four key business areas: Textile & Clothing Materials, Industrial Machinery & Materials, Human & Future Development, and Consumer Goods & Services. The Textile & Clothing Materials division focuses on the manufacturing and distribution of knitting wool suitable for fabrics and garments, along with materials and finished products for uniforms, and fashion textiles for both male and female attire. The Industrial Machinery & Materials segment is dedicated to the research, production, and sale of diverse materials, including wool, synthetic fibers, and various threads processed into twine, felt, and non-woven fabrics. This unit also designs, produces, and markets industrial equipment, in addition to designing, installing, and maintaining environmental and energy systems. The highly diversified Human & Future Development division offers an extensive array of services. These include various childcare solutions such as daycare and after-school care, small group home care, the rental and sale of welfare equipment, and home renovation services. It also manages commercial properties, children's amusement facilities, and operates businesses for ice cream sales, video rentals, snack distribution, and cellular phone services. Furthermore, this segment oversees sports and leisure amenities like tennis schools, golf courses, driving ranges, and equestrian clubs, alongside entertainment venues such as karaoke establishments and bowling alleys. Its real estate ventures include the leasing of office buildings, providing management for rental offices, selling land for housing, and constructing residential properties. The Consumer Goods & Services division provides a range of products, including ballroom dancing outfits, specialized inks for office and industrial use, general clothing, horse gear and other equestrian supplies, and stamps with related merchandise and services. Moreover, it functions as an insurance broker, offers logistics solutions, and sells home furnishings such as beds, bedding, and furniture via its online platform. Founded in 1896, The Japan Wool Textile Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
